-- Forwarded message -
From: Sofia Rodriguez <[contact omitted]>
Date: Thu, Apr 14, 2022 at 9:05 AM
Subject: Fwd: Request for Meeting between YouTube CEO Susan Wojcicki and Administrator Power
To: DDI.DRGTASKERS <[contact omitted]>
Cc: DDI Correspondence <[contact omitted]>
Hi DRG team,
Please see below for a meeting request for the Administrator. Given the topic of discussion it looks like there are DRG
equities. Please let me know if this should be directed to another hub.
"Susan would like to request a meeting with Administrator Power to discuss a range of critical issues of mutual interest
including: access to information globally; combating misinformation and disinformation globally, as well as YouTube's

positive economic, social, and civic impact, in democracies, as well as in closed and illiberal societies in across the the
world. She'd also love to discuss how we might work together on these shared values."
Thanks,
Sofie

From: Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Date: Wed, Apr 13, 2022 at 2:38 PM
Subject: Request for Meeting between YouTube CEO Susan Wojcicki and Administrator Power
To: Nikole Burroughs <[contact omitted]>, Colin Thomas-Jensen <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Sophia Lalani <[contact omitted]>
Hi USAID Friends,
I wanted to reach out to see if Administrator Power may be in town and interested in meeting with YouTube CEO,
Susan Wojcicki, who will be in Washington on April 28 and 29.
Susan would like to request a meeting with Administrator Power to discuss a range of critical issues of mutual interest
including: access to information globally; combating misinformation and disinformation globally, as well as YouTube's
positive economic, social, and civic impact, in democracies, as well as in closed and illiberal societies in across the the
world. She'd also love to discuss how we might work together on these shared values.
Please let me know if you have any questions or need any additional information from me (Susan's bio is below).
Many thanks,
Josh
Google
Public Policy
Joshua R. Blumenfel
[contact omitted] Manager, YouTube Government Affairs and Public Policı
/ Twitter
[opaque block] [contact omitted]
Susan's Bio
Susan Wojcicki is CEO of YouTube, the world's most popular digital video platform used by over two billion people
across the globe to access information, share video, and shape culture. An early champion of online video who was
instrumental in Google's 2006 acquisition of YouTube, Susan now oversees YouTube's content and business

operations, engineering, and product development.
Prior to joining YouTube in February 2014, Susan was Senior Vice President of Advertising & Commerce at Google,
where she oversaw the design and engineering of AdWords, AdSense, DoubleClick, and Google Analytics. She joined
Google in 1999 as the company's first marketing manager and led the initial development of several key consumer
products including Google Images and Google Books. In 2002, Susan began working on Google's advertising products
and over the next 12 years she led teams that helped define the vision and direction of Google's monetization
platforms.
Kylie Wilson (she/her/hers)
